_about: Average annual cost of attendance (tuition and fees, housing, food, books, other) in today's dollars, for picking an education goal. National averages vary a lot by state and school, so let the household override per child.
source: Rounded from College Board 'Trends in College Pricing' (2024-25 averages, total budget for on-campus students), adjusted to round numbers. Verify against current figures before relying on them.

CA._note: UC system total cost of attendance is roughly $40K/yr living on campus
